production: Built-in image_gen supplied the cavity artwork. Nearest-cell-center sampling produces its native 16x16 grid. tools/import_lumite_cavity.ps1 composites that interior into the exact user-supplied 16x16 vanilla stone and deepslate backgrounds and paints a rim by shading their original rock pixels at the same coordinates. Final opaque textures have 148 unchanged outer pixels, 49 painted rim pixels and 59 interior pixels. The original full cube geometry is restored; no recessed model is used.
